#Set Working Directory & Load Packages
```{r}
#set working directory
setwd("~/Desktop/blameassignment")

#load packages
library(psych)
library(effects)
library(corrplot)
library(corrgram)
library(stats)
library(plotrix)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

```

#Load in Anonymized Data (this is the file available on OSF)
```{r}
#load in data frame
qualtrics <- read.csv("Blame Assignment Study 5 Anon.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#no headers
df <- qualtrics %>%
  filter(DistributionChannel == "anonymous") #857 entries

#frequency of each ID
df.duplicateIDs <- df %>% 
  group_by(anon_id) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(freq=n())

#df that has only unique IDs
df.unique <- df.duplicateIDs %>%
  filter(freq == 1)

#only retain rows in original data file that are in the "unique" df
df.2 <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(anon_id %in% c(df.unique$anon_id))

#filter out anyone who did not identify as male/female
df.2 <- df.2 %>%
  filter(Gender == 1 | Gender == 2)

#filter out those who did not complete the survey
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(Progress==100)

#filter out those who did not consent
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(Q7==1)

```

#Data Cleaning
```{r}
#delete Qualtrics columns
df.2$Status <- NULL
df.2$Progress <- NULL
df.2$Duration..in.seconds. <- NULL
df.2$Finished <- NULL
df.2$RecipientLastName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientFirstName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientEmail <- NULL
df.2$ExternalReference <- NULL
df.2$DistributionChannel <- NULL
df.2$UserLanguage <- NULL

#turn all blanks to NA
df.2 <- df.2 %>% mutate_all(na_if,"")

```

#Make Condition Variable
```{r}
#condition
df.2$condition <- rep(NA,nrow(df.2))

df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$Q13_1)] <- 1 #Packed Both
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$Unpacked.men_1)] <- 2 #Unpacked Men
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$Unpacked.Women_1)] <- 3 #Unpacked Women
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$Q16_1)] <- 4 #Unpacked Both

table(df.2$condition)

```

#Rename Variables
```{r}
#consent
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(consent = Q7)

#demographics
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(gender = Gender) %>% 
  rename(age = Age) %>% 
  rename(race = Q13) %>% 
  rename(race_other = Q13_5_TEXT) %>% 
  rename(citizenship_other = citizenship_3_TEXT) %>% 
  rename(employment_status = employment.status) %>% 
  rename(employment_status_other = employment.status_7_TEXT) %>% 
  rename(position = Position)

#packed both
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(packedboth_1 = Q13_1) %>% 
  rename(packedboth_2 = Q13_2)

#unpacked men
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_1 = Unpacked.men_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_2 = Unpacked.men_2) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_3 = Unpacked.men_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_4 = Unpacked.men_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_5 = Unpacked.men_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_6 = Unpacked.men_6)

#unpacked women
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(unpackedwomen_1 = Unpacked.Women_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwomen_2 = Unpacked.Women_2) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwomen_3 = Unpacked.Women_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwomen_4 = Unpacked.Women_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwomen_5 = Unpacked.Women_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwomen_6 = Unpacked.Women_6)
  
#unpacked both
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_1 = Q16_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_2 = Q16_2) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_3 = Q16_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_4 = Q16_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_5 = Q16_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_6 = Q16_6) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_7 = Q16_7) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_8 = Q16_8) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_9 = Q16_9) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_10 = Q16_10)

```

#Finalize Clean Data
```{r}
#create new data frame
df.3 <- df.2

#check consent
table(df.3$consent)

#check conditions
table(df.3$condition)

#turn all variables to numeric
df.4 <- data.frame(lapply(df.3, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

```

#Data Demographics
```{r}
#gender
tablegender <- table(df.4$gender)
prop.table(tablegender)*100

#age
df.4 %>% summarize(mean_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#race
tablerace <- table(df.4$race)
prop.table(tablerace)*100

```

#Create Blame Variables
```{r}
#packed both
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c1_blamewomen = packedboth_1)

#unpacked men
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c2_blamewomen = unpackedmen_6)

#unpacked women
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c3_blamewomen = unpackedwomen_1 +
           unpackedwomen_2 +
           unpackedwomen_3 +
           unpackedwomen_4 +
           unpackedwomen_5)

#unpacked both
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c4_blamewomen = unpackedboth_6 +
           unpackedboth_7 +
           unpackedboth_8 +
           unpackedboth_9 +
           unpackedboth_10)

#blame women variable
df.4$blamewomen <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blamewomen <- pmax(df.4$c1_blamewomen, df.4$c2_blamewomen, df.4$c3_blamewomen, df.4$c4_blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE)

summary(df.4$blamewomen)

#blame men variable
df.4$blamemen <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blamemen <- 100-df.4$blamewomen

summary(df.4$blamemen)

```

#Analyses
```{r}
#Condition 1: packed both
#Condition 2: unpacked men
#Condition 3: unpacked women
#Condition 4: unpacked both

#turn numeric variables into factors
df.4$condition <- as.factor(df.4$condition)
df.4$gender <- as.factor(df.4$gender)
df.4$race <- as.factor(df.4$race)

#make binary variable for packed men
df.4$binarypackedmen <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$binarypackedmen <- ifelse(df.4$condition==1 | df.4$condition==3, 1, 0)

df.4$binarypackedmen <- as.factor(df.4$binarypackedmen)

#make binary variable for packed women
df.4$binarypackedwomen <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$binarypackedwomen <- ifelse(df.4$condition==1 | df.4$condition==2, 1, 0)

df.4$binarypackedwomen <- as.factor(df.4$binarypackedwomen)

#set ANOVA defaults to SPSS defaults
options(contrasts = c("contr.helmert", "contr.poly"))
options("contrasts")

library(car)
library(sjstats)

#3 way ANOVA
anova1 <- lm(blamewomen ~ binarypackedmen * binarypackedwomen * gender, data = df.4)

Anova(anova1,type=3)

anova1effect <-Anova(anova1,type=3)
eta_sq(anova1effect, partial = T)

#2 way ANOVA
anova2 <- lm(blamewomen ~ binarypackedmen * binarypackedwomen, data = df.4)

Anova(anova2,type=3)

anova2effect <-Anova(anova2,type=3)
eta_sq(anova2effect, partial = T)

#correlation
df.4$gender <- as.numeric(df.4$gender)

cor.test(df.4$gender, df.4$blamewomen)

df.4$gender <- as.factor(df.4$gender)

#summary statistics by condition
conditionsummarytable <- df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blamewomen=mean(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blamewomen=sd(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blamewomen=sd(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blamewomen=mean(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blamewomen=mean(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blamewomen, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

```

#online supplementary materials - blame assigned to each subgroup
```{r}
#Condition 1: packed both
#Condition 2: unpacked men
#Condition 3: unpacked women
#Condition 4: unpacked both


#Condition 1: packed both
df.condition1 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==1) %>% select(packedboth_1, packedboth_2)

df.condition1 <- df.condition1 %>% 
  rename(women = packedboth_1) %>% 
  rename(men = packedboth_2)

df.condition1 <- df.condition1 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition1.long <- df.condition1 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "packedboth_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition1table <- df.condition1.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)


#Condition 2: unpacked men

df.condition2 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==2) %>% select(unpackedmen_1, unpackedmen_2, unpackedmen_3, unpackedmen_4, unpackedmen_5, unpackedmen_6)

df.condition2 <- df.condition2 %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_whitemen = unpackedmen_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_blackmen = unpackedmen_2) %>%
  rename(unpackedmen_asianmen = unpackedmen_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_hispanicmen = unpackedmen_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_othermen = unpackedmen_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedmen_women = unpackedmen_6)

df.condition2 <- df.condition2 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition2.long <- df.condition2 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "unpackedmen_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition2table <- df.condition2.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)


#Condition 3: unpacked women

df.condition3 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==3) %>% select(unpackedwomen_1, unpackedwomen_2, unpackedwomen_3, unpackedwomen_4, unpackedwomen_5, unpackedwomen_6)

df.condition3 <- df.condition3 %>%

  rename(unpackedwomen_asianwomen = unpackedwomen_3) %>%

df.condition3 <- df.condition3 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition3.long <- df.condition3 %>% pivot_longer(

condition3table <- df.condition3.long %>% group_by(group) %>%
```
